workflows.name: Know what the news says about your brand
workflows.description: Filter a brand-search feed into linked mentions and an overall tone report, ready for your webhook.
workflows.author: 0design
workflows.value: Know what the news says about your brand

acceptance.scope: Registry composition and real user execution; historical output is not acceptance

brief.summary: Filter a brand-search feed into linked mentions and an overall tone report, ready for your webhook.
howItWorks: Reads up to 10 items from the feed at QCORE_SOURCE_URL.
A model keeps only items that really discuss the brand: publication, one sentence, link.
It adds a final TONE line (positive / neutral / negative / mixed), or replies exactly 'No mentions today.'
The text is POSTed as {"text": …} to QCORE_WEBHOOK_URL.
inputs: A feed URL that already searches for your brand (e.g. a news search RSS).
outputs: A short plain-text list of mentions with a tone line, POSTed to your webhook, or a file in .qf/out/ if no webhook is set.

knobs.name: instructions
knobs.what: Line format and tone rule, in the bm-filter step of the manifest.

knobs.name: settings.budgetUsd
knobs.what: Per-run spending cap, $0.10 in the manifest.

knobs.name: OPENROUTER_MODEL
knobs.what: Model used on the OpenRouter route (env var).

access: An RSS feed URL for your brand search
A webhook receiver URL (optional)
OpenRouter API key, only on the OpenRouter route

providers.how: As published: OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment (default secretSource env). Set OPENROUTER_MODEL (no model in the manifest).

Edited copy: in bm-filter add provider: cli and input: "{{steps.bm-fetch.output}}", set settings.budgetUsd: null, run q-core run --caller-provider provider.json (agent claude|codex), answer each job with q-core reply. Add a human approval-gate before bm-send (required in edited copies).

env.name: QCORE_SOURCE_URL
env.what: URL of the RSS/Atom feed to read

env.name: QCORE_WEBHOOK_URL
env.what: Receiver URL for the POST; if unset, the payload goes to .qf/out/

env.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env.what: OpenRouter key, read from the environment; only on the OpenRouter route

env.name: OPENROUTER_MODEL
env.what: OpenRouter model id; no model is set in the manifest; only on the OpenRouter route

brief.price: OpenRouter: not measured; capped at $0.10 per run by the manifest, depends on the model you set. CLI route: no separate model bill, uses your agent subscription.
limits: Reference example: shows the manifest format; no measured result and no accepted real run.

brief.summary: Draft a Telegram post from source material, check its rules, and review the exact text before publishing.
howItWorks: Fetches JSON material from QCORE_SOURCE_URL.

input.notes: One step-output reference, for example {{steps.unique.output}}; the model then sees only that value instead of every prior output (capped at 60 000 characters). A reference that does not resolve fails before anything is sent.

secretSource.notes: env | keychain. Default env. keychain reads the key from the local macOS Keychain (service com.qfactory.q-core.openrouter, account openrouter:<keyRef>; store it with q-core auth set openrouter); the key never appears in the workflow, environment or run record.

keyRef.notes: Uppercase secret alias, default OPENROUTER_API_KEY. With secretSource env it names the environment variable; with keychain it names the Keychain entry.

retries.notes: 0..5, default 2. At most retries + 1 billable attempts; retried only on network, timeout, 429 and 5xx. Out of range fails the step before the key is read.

maxCallCostUsd.notes: Optional per-call money cap in USD, (0, 100]. The worst case of every attempt at the model's listed price must fit, or the call is not made (COST_LIMIT); a model with no listed price is refused (COST_UNKNOWN).

json.notes: When format: json, the output is the parsed object instead of {text, model}.

costUsd.notes: Run record: costUsd is the provider's reported cost (costSource provider), else the listed price of the model that answered (rate-table), else null (unknown). A finite budgetUsd stops the next paid step while any cost is unknown.
